We confirm hardware sent to Rotterdam was misrouted and corrected to **Pune DC** (PO: RDC-1804-V60-JOT). A refund of **€120** for the reshipping fee (Invoice **FEES_GMX-X_36**) has been issued to your registered card on file. This will reflect in 3–5 business days.

**Expected Delivery Window**: PO **RDC-1804-V60-JOT** will re-route through our accelerated channel. A confirmation email is being sent by VZZ logistics.

Thank you for your patience.

—VZZ CRM Team
